restricted.label: Authorized mode
restricted.help: Only the members checked below can create occasions.

removeMemberConfirm: Remove {{name}} from the organization? They will no longer see its “all members” occasions and will no longer be able to create any.
deleteConfirm: Delete the organization “{{name}}”? Its occasions are kept, without an organization.
logoFormats: PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or SVG · 2 MB max
membersHelp: People who open the link of one of the organization's occasions become members automatically. Administrators manage the organization and the guests of its occasions, like the owner.
membersHelpFree: In open mode, all members can create occasions.
createLockedFree: Open mode: all members can create
createLockedAdmin: The owner and admins can always create
removedHelp: Opening a link does not bring them back automatically.
